slides.title: Check the check **you trust most**
slides.scene: Corey the sprout wears a detective's hat and holds a giant magnifying glass up to a smiling green traffic light, inspecting it suspiciously from very close, while the traffic light sweats nervously. Funny, bright, simple background.

items.title: Pick one
items.text: The pipeline, monitor or backup job you'd bet on.

items.title: Write two questions
items.text: The one it answers, and the one you think it answers.

items.title: Ask the second
items.text: Not "did anything fail?" but "did anything happen?"

items.title: Add a boring assertion
items.text: Does a run exist for this commit? Nothing more.

items.title: Give "can't tell" its own exit
items.text: 0 ran, 1 never ran, 2 couldn't find out.

items.title: Test the tester
items.text: Mine passed for the wrong reason first time.
